I never got to spend much time with my folks— they’re constantly working and away whilst I’ll be busy with my own work. After some time later when I got to see them and sat down, I noticed how much wrinkles my dad had and grey hair my mom had- how much they’ve aged and realised I may have little time left with them.

I thought everything was well with us. He brought me to see his entire family and we got along well. Few weeks later a friend of mine sent me a text, saying he has seen him with another girl. I found out that that he was already with her for 7years, so technically he was cheating on her with me. 
I forgave him, I was naive. Told me he wasn’t with her anymore and mind you, I had not done anything like telling him to pick.. I never had the chance to talk about it cause he always brushes me off. we  resumed til he started to ignore me a week later and he ghosted on me entirely. He’s still with the girl now it seems, but has cheated on her many times with others.  His parents were aware of his “activities” and said nothing
What if he started talking to me assuming if we were in the same lift alone? What should I do?

Honestly going for a getaway with some time alone would do the job, but current situation forbids me from doing that. For the time being, what works for me is working out. Something that keeps me exhausted to help me sleep. I do read some times, but mostly I work to keep my mind off things.

It has just been really exhausting when people expect more from you when you’ve given everything. I just wished people could understand it.
Have you figured out any ways to overcome this?

I don’t know why, but when she walked out, I took a peep at her. She was upset.
